_comment: Iframe-domain knowledge base for the DaddyLive family. Maintained by scripts/selfheal-iframe-domains.js. 'family' keys are registrable-domain-ish suffixes; rotating node prefixes are collapsed onto them.

assetrage.net.note: Dominant embed domain (~80% of live channels). Existing decodeEconfig works.

dynproclaim.net.note: Reached as a nested hop (e.g. from w1.sportsonlinee.click). 32-hex per-channel subdomain. Same decodeEconfig as assetrage; terminal host is a737cozfwjmm.net / 7odxv0l067ka.net.

sportsonlinee.click.note: Thin wrapper; its only content is an iframe pointing at *.dynproclaim.net.

streame.center.note: Needs TWO hops: /embed/chN.php -> /embed/hls2.php?stream= -> manifest on edgestream*.pro.

vertex.st.note: Page calls api/player.php?id=N which returns {"url":"https://play.matchli.st/..."}. No _econfig, no iframe src. Id must be taken from loadPlayerChannel(N), not the template string.

matchli.st.note: Terminal embed for vertex.st. Manifest sits in window.PP_CLAPPR_CONFIG as JSON with escaped \u0026.

rockystream.st.note: atob decodes to an already-registered provider (embed.st); no new decoder needed.

videocdn-4726.website.note: Returned HTTP 403 on every attempt; unresolved. Likely geo-gated. Left alone deliberately.

embed.st.note: Already registered provider; handled by EmbedStProvider/EmbedIndiaProvider.

edgestream.pro.note: Node number rotates (edgestream2/5/7.pro all observed). Match the family.

hockey.do.note: FLAKY: 200/live, 403, 404 and timeouts observed within minutes; outcome did not correlate with Referer. URL construction verified correct. Left as-is by decision.
